paragraphs.text: This is a timeline of Magic: The Gathering sets and storyline sources . It is an unofficial document, but all information on it is taken from official statements or canon sources. All stories that could be dated, or could not be dated but could be placed at some point in the timeline because of their connection to other stories, have been incorporated to the fullest possible extent. Note that this timeline is not perfectly accurate, and some events have an estimated date or a date range in which they could have occurred.
